items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: I had a maid named Georgia who was taking care of Rex when he was little.

ctx.x: So Jaffe calls me on the phone, tells me what happened and he says, I'm sure that Louie doesn't know anything about that and you can probably get to him. I said, okay. So I called the hotel, I called the Roosevelt, talked with Ira, told him the situation. And I said, tell him to give me a ring when he gets back. So Ira said, I'm sure he will. Well, I had to go out for a few minutes. And I did. I had a maid named Georgia who was taking care of Rex when he was little. And, uh, so he called while I was gone. Georgia…
Well, did he have, this is another question, did he have, what type of relationship did he have with the New Orleans Jazz Club?
